goal: Lô 0 of the Chat knowledge proposal (2026-11-24): remove unsourced quotations from persona detail pages, relabel the fake-activity section, add the Books filter chip and more than one book among featured cards, give each persona its own opening line, derive the Oracle guide list from persona data with a drift check, and add two book personas (Kinh Pháp Cú, Kinh Dịch).
successCriteria: No persona detail text is presented in quotation marks as a verbatim line of a figure or book unless widely attested; paraphrases are labelled as the spirit of the guide.
The section formerly named Dấu vết gần đây is labelled as suggested topics in Vietnamese and English.
The Chat hub shows a Sách / Books chip and the eight featured cards include more than one book.
The persona chat room opens with a per-persona opening line and falls back to the previous generic text.
Oracle lists all personas as guides from a generated file and validate:data fails if that file drifts from persona data.
book-dhammapada and book-i-ching exist in every registry where book personas appear, with passing data, visual-asset, admin and mobile checks.
untouchedSurfaces: ai-persona-chat, the prompt assembler, the model router, packages/agent-config, migrations and the knowledge-briefs content folder are owned by other agents and are not edited.
No Edge Function is deployed and no SQL is run; regenerated seed files are only written locally.

impact.entryPoint: Trò chuyện hub (filter chips, featured cards), persona detail page labels, persona chat room opening bubble, Oracle guide suggestions.
impact.dataWrite: Static content JSON and generated seed files change; no remote database write is performed by this change.
impact.backendContract: Oracle ask_guide now accepts the five missing guide slugs plus the two new books; the response shape is unchanged. Deploy of ai-oracle-turn is left to the Owner.
impact.canonicalContract: Proposal CHAT_KNOWLEDGE_CHARACTERS_2026-11-24 sections 2, 3 and 9 (Lô 0); persona-short-names.json covers exactly every persona.
impact.adminVisibility: Admin seed (apps/admin/generated/content-seed.json) is regenerated so the two new personas appear in Admin lists after the next Admin deploy.
impact.privacySafety: Respectful, non-sectarian copy for Pháp Cú; Kinh Dịch is framed as a classic of change, not fortune-telling; transparency notes say the guide is not the book, author or any tradition.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; the seed SQL is not applied remotely until the Owner approves it.
